details.description:
ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Health Nutrition Since 1968, Royal Canin has been following the belief that nutrition plays a key role in supporting the health and wellbeing of cats and dogs. This is why we have designed ROYAL CANIN® veterinary diets around proven nutritional science in partnership with pet professionals and experts, delivering nutrition for pets with specific health needs.

Support healthy joint function with ROYAL CANIN® Mobility Support adult dry dog food. ROYAL CANIN® Mobility Support is a precisely balanced, nutritious diet that is specifically formulated to help support your dog's healthy joint function. 

ROYAL CANIN® Mobility dog food is suitable for:
•	Helping to support healthy joint function.
•	Helping to support joints after orthopaedic surgery.

Key benefits:
•	Joint complex
o	To help maintain healthy joints, this diet is specially formulated with New Zealand Green Lipped mussel extract. 
•	Omega-3
o	This diet is enriched with omega-3 fatty acids to help maintain healthy joints. 
•	Moderate Calorie:
o	When dogs are overweight, their joints can be placed under stress. This diet contains a moderate calorie content to help your dog maintain an ideal body weight, ultimately supporting joint health. 

Royal Canin are proud to partner with leading veterinary scientists to produce a mobility food for dogs. As part of the ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only given to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. Transitioning your pet from one diet to another should be a smooth and gradual process over a 7-10-day period. Please ensure you follow the correct rationing amount. 

Please note: Royal Mobility Support is not suitable for growth, gestation or lactation.

nutritionalInfo.description: Composition: Rice, maize flour, dehydrated poultry protein, maize, maize gluten, hydrolysed animal proteins, animal fats, beet pulp, vegetable fibres, fish oil, minerals, wheat gluten*, soya oil, New Zealand green-lipped mussel extract (GLM) (0.30%), glucosamine from fermentation (0.10%), marigold meal, hydrolysed cartilage (source of chondroitin) (0.001%).
nutritionalInfo.title: pa.nutritionalInformation.composition

nutritionalInfo.description:
Additives (per kg)**: Nutritional additives: Vitamin A: 22000 IU, Vitamin D3: 1025 IU, Iron (3b103): 41 mg, Iodine (3b201, 3b202): 4.1 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 13 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b504): 53 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 138 mg, Selenium (3b801, 3b811, 3b812): 0.09 mg - Technological additives: Clinoptilolite of sedimentary origin: 5 g - Preservatives - Antioxidants. 
**Values reflect only levels added to the formula, not those naturally occurring in components of the diet.
